messages:
maria (support): Customer escalated: rerank endpoint returning weird scores and sometimes 400 when they copy cURL from Console. They pasted the cURL and got 422 parsing error.

maria (support): Their copied payload (from Console > Copy as cURL) looked like:
```bash
curl 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-raw $'{\"query\":\"Which is best?\",\"candidates\":[\"A\",\"B\",\"C\"]}'
```

maria (support): On mac zsh they get: "parse error: Invalid numeric literal at line 1 column 6" and scores come back all zeros in another case.

sam (eng-ml): I suspect the $'...' quoting from the Console copy inserts shell-escaped sequences. Some shells don't like $'...' or they treat backslash escapes differently. Also if Content-Type header is missing our server will try to parse form data -> weird behavior.

eli (docs): Hmm we recently switched docs to show --data-raw with $'...' for readability. Maybe Console copy is reusing that snippet. That's probably causing confusion. I'll audit the docs and console snippets.

lisa (support lead): @maria can you paste the exact curl output from customer (redact key)? we need raw bytes if possible.

maria (support): pasted, redacted:
```bash
curl 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-raw $'{\"query\":\"Which is best?\",\"candidates\":[\"A\",\"B\",\"C\"]}'
```

sam (eng-ml): Notice the payload is double-escaped: backslashes before quotes inside $'...'. Some shells will strip the backslashes and send correct JSON, others will send literally backslashes causing our JSON parser to see invalid tokens. Also if candidates length > 150 we currently cap and return zeros — that's a secondary bug.

jordan (prod-eng): Filing RERANK-512. Quick mitigation: our API should accept text/plain bodies and try to unescape common shell wrappers; we'll add tolerant parsing. For customers now, recommend removing $'...' wrapper or use --data-binary @payload.json.

maria (support): Workaround I sent: save payload.json and:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @payload.json
```

eli (docs): I'll update docs and Console copy button to not inject $'...' and to offer a PowerShell variant. Also add note about candidate limits and expected score ranges.

deploy-bot: Created issue RERANK-512 and draft PR at https://github.com/redwood-inference/rerank/pull/245

lisa (support lead): Thanks team. I'll follow up with the customer and offer the file-based workaround.
